top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
161ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
10,400ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre. Practice on paved Alpine roads with iconic unpaved summit: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 64 miles.
At Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
10,400ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre. Train it until it feels boring.
64 miles on paved Alpine roads with iconic unpaved summit burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,400ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved Alpine roads with iconic unpaved summit can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Base fitness for Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre's 64 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Sestriere — Colle delle Finestre rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved alpine roads with iconic unpaved summit to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, TT Threshold, and VO2max to prepare you for 64 miles of paved alpine roads with iconic unpaved summit in Cesana Torinese, Piedmont, Italy.
